title: You ship faster. You drift faster.
summary: Ntive Labs, Inc. presents Parive’s source-traceable comparison of native iOS and Android behavior, using Wikipedia’s apps to distinguish intentional divergence from overlooked parity gaps. The public preview is a frozen analysis snapshot; planning and implementation agents are shown only in private demos. An iOS team can review the evidence behind each difference and approve a repair plan before accepting code and parity tests.
takeaway: Classify platform differences as intentional, pending, or accidental, verify each finding against source, and approve a repair plan before reviewing the resulting code and parity tests.
